ego_extraction.note: Documented-only (a UCINET procedure that builds the ego networks of all nodes as separate datasets); the sources give no formula beyond the construction of the ego networks, whose node sets and induced ties are defined under ego members and ego ties.

ego_composition.note: Documented only (egor, UCINET), never run. Formulas for alter shares, the Blau index and Shannon entropy are the standard definitions; the measure's own variants (index of qualitative variation normalisation, handling of missing attribute values) are not recorded in the sources.

notation.meaning: set of alters of ego \(v\), with \(|A_v|=s\)
share of alters in category \(c\) of a categorical attribute: \(|\{u\in A_v: x_u=c\}|/s\)
number of categories

formulas.name: Blau heterogeneity
formulas.where: Probability that two randomly drawn alters (with replacement) are in different categories; needs \(s\ge1\).

formulas.name: Shannon heterogeneity
formulas.where: Entropy of the alter composition; 0 for a single category.

formulas.name: Index of qualitative variation
formulas.where: Blau index divided by its maximum \(1-1/K\); needs \(K\ge2\).

variants.ego_composition: The alter category shares \(p_c\) and the three heterogeneity indices above, computed for one categorical attribute of the alters.
